mentions.name: Solenoid-driven self-playing piano
mentions.description: This project wires a piano soundboard with 24 solenoids, drivers, and related electronics to build a self-playing piano that strikes the strings directly instead of using hammers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a piano's soundboard and 24 solenoids, all the drivers, etc I need to wire up to make a self playing piano (ish, I mean, it won't be hitting hammers - directly solenoid to string)
